Update volume, pool, slots, job or statistics.

## Synopsis

```text
update
update volume[=<volume>] [volstatus=<volstatus>] [volretention=<volretention>]
                        [voluse=<voluse>] [maxvoljobs=<maxvoljobs>]
                        [maxvolfiles=<maxvolfiles>]
                        [maxvolbytes=<maxvolbytes>] [recycle=<yes|no>]
                        [inchanger=<yes|no>] [slot=<slot>] [pool=<pool>]
                        [recyclepool=<recyclepool>] [fromallpools]
                        [allfrompool=<allfrompool>] [enabled=<yes|no>]
                        [actiononpurge=<Truncate|None>] [storage=<storage>]
                        [encrypt=<yes|no|rotate>]
update pool[=<pool>] [maxvolbytes=<maxvolbytes>] [maxvolfiles=<maxvolfiles>]
                     [maxvoljobs=<maxvoljobs>] [enabled=<yes|no>]
                     [recyclepool=<recyclepool>]
                     [actiononpurge=<actiononpurge>]
update slots[=<slots>] [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>] [<storage-name>] [scan]
                       [drive=<drive>] [enabled=<yes|no>]
update jobid=<jobid> [jobname=<jobname>] [starttime=<starttime>]
                     [client=<client>] [filesetid=<filesetid>]
                     [jobtype=<jobtype>]
update stats [days=<days>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Changes catalog records of volumes, pools, slots and jobs; without arguments the Director asks what to update.

## Subcommands

### update volume {#sub-update-volume}

**Volume record.**

Aliases: `media`

Changes the catalog properties of one volume: volstatus (Append, Archive, Disabled, Full, Used, Cleaning, Recycle, Read-Only, Error), volretention, voluse, maxvoljobs, maxvolfiles, maxvolbytes, recycle, inchanger, slot, enabled, encrypt, pool, recyclepool, actiononpurge and storage. Several parameters may be given on one line; each is checked and reported on its own. Without parameters a menu opens, without a name the volume is selected first.

allfrompool=&lt;pool&gt; resets the defaults of all volumes of a pool from the Pool resource, fromallpools those of every pool. encrypt=yes|no|rotate sets, removes or renews the hardware encryption key and only applies to volumes with a key.

```text
update volume[=<volume>] [volstatus=<volstatus>] [volretention=<volretention>]
                        [voluse=<voluse>] [maxvoljobs=<maxvoljobs>]
                        [maxvolfiles=<maxvolfiles>]
                        [maxvolbytes=<maxvolbytes>] [recycle=<yes|no>]
                        [inchanger=<yes|no>] [slot=<slot>] [pool=<pool>]
                        [recyclepool=<recyclepool>] [fromallpools]
                        [allfrompool=<allfrompool>] [enabled=<yes|no>]
                        [actiononpurge=<Truncate|None>] [storage=<storage>]
                        [encrypt=<yes|no|rotate>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `volume=` | resource | from [`.media`](../dot-media/) |  | value optional | Volume name. |
| `volstatus=` | enum | `Append`, `Archive`, `Disabled`, `Full`, `Used`, `Cleaning`, `Read-Only`, `Recycle`, `Purged`, `Error` |  |  | Volume status. |
| `volretention=` | string |  |  |  | Retention time. |
| `voluse=` | string |  |  |  | Use duration. |
| `maxvoljobs=` | integer |  |  |  | Most jobs. |
| `maxvolfiles=` | integer |  |  |  | Most files. |
| `maxvolbytes=` | string |  |  |  | Most bytes. |
| `recycle=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Recycle. |
| `inchanger=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | In changer. |
| `slot=` | integer |  |  |  | Slot. |
| `pool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Move to pool. |
| `recyclepool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Recycle pool. |
| `fromallpools` | keyword |  |  |  | Pool defaults for every volume. |
| `allfrompool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Pool defaults for the volumes of a pool. |
| `enabled=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Enabled. |
| `actiononpurge=` | enum | `Truncate`, `None` |  |  | Action on purge. |
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |
| `encrypt=` | enum | `yes`, `no`, `rotate` |  |  | Encryption. |

Change several limits at once:

```text
update volume=Full-0001 volretention=30days maxvolbytes=10G recycle=no
```

Move a volume to another pool:

```text
update volume=Full-0001 pool=Incremental
```

Reapply the pool defaults to all volumes of Full:

```text
update volume allfrompool=Full
```

### update pool {#sub-update-pool}

**Pool record from the resource.**

Updates the catalog Pool record from the Pool resource of the configuration and shows the record afterwards. Use it after changing a pool in the configuration; without a name the pool is chosen from a list. To create a missing Pool record use create.

```text
update pool[=<pool>] [maxvolbytes=<maxvolbytes>] [maxvolfiles=<maxvolfiles>]
                     [maxvoljobs=<maxvoljobs>] [enabled=<yes|no>]
                     [recyclepool=<recyclepool>]
                     [actiononpurge=<actiononpurge>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  | value optional | Pool name. |
| `maxvolbytes=` | string |  |  |  | Most bytes. |
| `maxvolfiles=` | integer |  |  |  | Most files. |
| `maxvoljobs=` | integer |  |  |  | Most jobs. |
| `enabled=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Enabled. |
| `recyclepool=` | resource | from [`.pools`](../dot-pools/) |  |  | Recycle pool. |
| `actiononpurge=` | string |  |  |  | Action on purge. |

Refresh the catalog record of pool Full:

```text
update pool=Full
```

### update slots {#sub-update-slots}

**Slots from the autochanger.**

Aliases: `slot`

Asks the Storage Daemon for the contents of an autochanger and records slot and InChanger for the volumes found. It is the only form of update that contacts the Storage Daemon. Without storage= only autochanger storages are offered; a slot list restricts the update.

scan loads volumes one by one into the drive given by drive= and reads their labels, for changers without a barcode reader. enabled= sets the Enabled value of the volumes found.

```text
update slots[=<slots>] [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>] [<storage-name>] [scan]
                       [drive=<drive>] [enabled=<yes|no>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slots=` | string |  |  | value optional | Slots (list or ranges). |
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name. |
| `sd=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name (as storage=). |
| `<storage-name>` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  | positional | Storage name without key. |
| `scan` | keyword |  |  |  | Read the labels. |
| `drive=` | integer |  |  |  | Drive number. |
| `enabled=` | bool | `yes`, `no` |  |  | Enable or disable the volumes. |

Refresh all slots of the autochanger:

```text
update slots storage=Autochanger
```

Read the labels in slots 1 to 3 and 7:

```text
update slots=1-3,7 storage=Autochanger scan drive=0
```

### update jobid {#sub-update-jobid}

**Job record.**

Changes fields of one job record without confirmation: jobname, starttime (YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, quoted because of the blank), client, filesetid and jobtype. Without any field the Director reports that nothing was specified; an unknown JobId is reported by the catalog.

```text
update jobid=<jobid> [jobname=<jobname>] [starttime=<starttime>]
                     [client=<client>] [filesetid=<filesetid>]
                     [jobtype=<jobtype>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | integer |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `jobname=` | string |  |  |  | Job name. |
| `starttime=` | string |  |  |  | Start time. |
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name. |
| `filesetid=` | integer |  |  |  | FileSet ID. |
| `jobtype=` | string |  |  |  | Job type letter. |

Rename the job of a record:

```text
update jobid=506 jobname=DocsRenamed
```

Correct the start time of a job:

```text
update jobid=506 starttime="2026-10-01 10:00:00"
```

### update stats {#sub-update-stats}

**Job statistics.**

Carries the long-term job statistics forward by copying finished jobs into the statistics tables. days= takes only jobs of the last given number of days into account. The Director reports how many jobs were updated.

```text
update stats [days=<days>]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `days=` | integer |  |  |  | Keep this many days. |

Update the statistics with the last 30 days:

```text
update stats days=30
```

## Examples

Choose what to update from the menu:

```text
update
```

Set the status of one volume:

```text
update volume=Full-0001 volstatus=Used
```
